mapper.insert: insert into structure_row (table_id, project_id, side, note_no, table_title, row_key, row_path, row_leaf, item_key, row_order, source_locator, created_at, updated_at) values (#{tableId}, #{projectId}, #{side}, #{noteNo}, #{tableTitle}, #{rowKey}, #{rowPath}, #{rowLeaf}, #{itemKey}, #{rowOrder}, #{sourceLocator}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: delete from structure_row where project_id = #{projectId} and side = #{side}
mapper.select: select * from structure_row where table_id = #{tableId} order by row_order, id
